title: Producer-Consumer Queue Race Condition
root_cause: Test uses time.sleep(0.020) to wait for consumer thread to drain 10 events. Consumer does SHA-256 + 1ms sleep per event (~10-15ms total). Under cpu_heavy_load, GIL contention + OS scheduling delays push consumer time to 50-200ms+, far exceeding the 20ms wait.

naive_quick_fix.description: Increases sleep from 0.020 to 0.200. Still fails >25% under cpu_heavy_load because consumer can take 150-300ms.

certified_real_fix.description: Uses wait_for_drain(timeout=5.0) which internally calls thread.join(). Immune to CPU load.
